description: This file defines a class for gzip compression handling, including methods for compression and decompression using PHP's gzcompress and gzuncompress functions. It also manages compression level and minimum data length settings.

classes.name: ADODB_Compress_Gzip
classes.description: A class providing gzip compression and decompression functionalities with configurable compression level and minimum length settings.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the compression level, must be between 0 and 9.

methods.name: getMinLength
methods.description: Returns the current minimum length for data to be compressed.

methods.name: setMinLength
methods.description: Sets the minimum data length to apply compression.

methods.name: ADODB_Compress_Gzip
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the compression level and minimum length if provided.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Compresses the data if it exceeds the minimum length; otherwise returns it as-is.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Decompresses provided data. Returns data as-is if it's empty.
